events.title: Disaster at the Monongahela
events.description: During the French and Indian War, a British force under General Edward Braddock, marching toward Fort Duquesne, was ambushed by French and Native American forces. The British and colonial troops suffered a devastating defeat.
events.significance: The defeat shattered British confidence on the American frontier early in the war. It also gave a young Virginia officer, George Washington, who survived the battle, formative experience in command.

events.title: Argentina Declares Independence
events.description: Meeting in San Miguel de Tucumán, the Congress of Tucumán declared the independence of the United Provinces of South America from Spain.
events.significance: The declaration is the founding moment of the Argentine nation. Argentines still celebrate it every year as Independence Day.

events.title: President Zachary Taylor Dies in Office
events.description: Sixteen months into his term, the 12th U.S. President died suddenly in the White House. Vice President Millard Fillmore succeeded him.
events.significance: Taylor's death brought a new president to the White House in the middle of the crisis over slavery and the Compromise of 1850. Fillmore supported the Compromise, and it was passed soon afterward.

events.title: The Fourteenth Amendment Is Ratified
events.description: The Fourteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution was ratified. It guaranteed citizenship to African Americans and promised all persons due process and equal protection of the law.
events.significance: It became one of the most consequential amendments in American history. It is the basis for landmark civil rights rulings in the century and a half since.

events.title: South Sudan Becomes a Nation
events.description: The Republic of South Sudan declared its independence from Sudan and became Africa's 54th country.
events.significance: Independence followed decades of civil war and a referendum in which the people voted overwhelmingly to separate. It made South Sudan the world's newest country at the time.
